promotion_rule: ALL mandatory gates must PASS; no weighted average, waiver by silence, or partial-pass promotion.
search_truth_rule: A Matrix-grade build may truthfully return HOLD/UNKNOWN for an individual search. Build acceptance measures correct behavior, not fabricated certainty.

mandatory_gates.name: Typed intent model / Measured Intent boundary
mandatory_gates.test: Query produces explicit constraints, defensibly measured intent, latent hypotheses, weights, unknowns, action target and provenance; inferred intent is not silently promoted to fact.

mandatory_gates.name: Latent-intent plurality
mandatory_gates.test: Ambiguous query preserves multiple plausible intent hypotheses until evidence justifies collapse.

mandatory_gates.name: Intent posterior update
mandatory_gates.test: Material new evidence changes hypothesis probabilities/weights without restarting valid prior work.

mandatory_gates.name: Hidden-variable detection
mandatory_gates.test: Decision-sensitive implicit variables are generated and tested.

mandatory_gates.name: Permission-aware scope routing
mandatory_gates.test: Only authorized internal/client/market/web/connected scopes may participate.

mandatory_gates.name: Claim normalization
mandatory_gates.test: Marketing/raw text is normalized into comparable typed claims before ranking.

mandatory_gates.name: Provenance
mandatory_gates.test: Every material ranked claim is traceable to source, timestamp/freshness and evidence pointer.

mandatory_gates.name: Contradiction preservation
mandatory_gates.test: Conflicting credible claims are not silently merged or averaged.

mandatory_gates.name: Cross-chain join discipline
mandatory_gates.test: No causal/identity relation is synthesized without an evidenced join.

mandatory_gates.name: Freshness sensitivity
mandatory_gates.test: Time-sensitive attributes such as price/stock/state decay or require current evidence.

mandatory_gates.name: Expected Intent Fulfilment over Measured Intent
mandatory_gates.test: Candidate ranking exposes reproducible probability-weighted intent utility inputs and result, anchored to the defensibly measured intent layer plus explicitly uncertain latent hypotheses.

mandatory_gates.name: Expected Regret controller
mandatory_gates.test: Search continuation/stop decision responds to remaining decision-sensitive uncertainty.

mandatory_gates.name: Decision stability
mandatory_gates.test: Engine tests whether plausible remaining uncertainty could materially change winner/ranking/action.

mandatory_gates.name: Truthful HOLD
mandatory_gates.test: Insufficient evidence returns HOLD/UNKNOWN rather than synthetic certainty.

mandatory_gates.name: Provider failure discipline
mandatory_gates.test: Intent/search provider outage does not silently downgrade into keyword search branded as CARBON Search.

mandatory_gates.name: Result compression
mandatory_gates.test: Default output is decision-grade and concise while evidence remains inspectable.

mandatory_gates.name: Action routing
mandatory_gates.test: Result maps to an authorized next action or explicit HOLD; no authority is invented.

mandatory_gates.name: Outcome learning
mandatory_gates.test: Feedback can update versioned calibration without rewriting historical evidence.

mandatory_gates.name: Internal evidence scenario
mandatory_gates.test: End-to-end CARBON internal search passes with state/provenance awareness.

mandatory_gates.name: External decision scenario
mandatory_gates.test: Phone-style ambiguous product search identifies anomaly, decomposes hidden specification, updates latent intent and ranks actionable alternatives.

mandatory_gates.name: Marketplace scenario
mandatory_gates.test: Marketplace-of-Intent integration resolves demand/supply signals through the same intent engine once authoritative contract is connected.

mandatory_gates.name: Privacy isolation
mandatory_gates.test: Private/client evidence cannot leak into unauthorized/public result surfaces.

mandatory_gates.name: Audit receipt
mandatory_gates.test: Each search records model version/provider, intent snapshot, sources, claims, scores, stop reason and action without exposing private chain-of-thought.

mandatory_gates.name: Regression suite
mandatory_gates.test: All prior mandatory search acceptance vectors pass after any consequential engine change.

mandatory_gates.name: Deployment readback
mandatory_gates.test: Deployed runtime is tested end-to-end against the same build commit/config and returns the expected bounded outcomes.

mandatory_gates.name: Matrix-wide callable capability
mandatory_gates.test: An authorized non-CARBON Matrix caller can invoke the same versioned CARBON Search engine through a thin shared interface and receive a valid decision/HOLD contract without embedding a duplicate intent engine.

mandatory_gates.name: Shared capability permission boundary
mandatory_gates.test: Matrix-wide invocation preserves caller/scope ACLs at the Search capability boundary; a caller cannot gain unauthorized private/client/Matrix evidence access through Search.

mandatory_gates.name: Capability version and upgrade continuity
mandatory_gates.test: Search responses expose capability/contract version and compatible callers continue to use the shared engine after an engine upgrade without independent copied-logic rewrites; incompatible changes fail explicitly.

mandatory_gates.name: Surface parity
mandatory_gates.test: Human/Owner, Matrix-worker, client and public surfaces invoke the same core intent-resolution semantics; differences are limited to authorized context, scopes, actions and disclosure.

mandatory_gates.name: Canonical directory / ontology discipline
mandatory_gates.test: Search keeps products, services, capabilities, utilities, marketplace offers, evidence records and other canonical entity types distinct using versioned IDs/aliases/relationships; similar names or tags cannot silently merge identities.

mandatory_gates.name: Active-search correction and rollback
mandatory_gates.test: When a wrong claim/entity/mapping/hypothesis/ranking is detected mid-search, the engine invalidates only dependent state, preserves unaffected evidence, reweights intent, continues from the furthest valid state and does not terminate solely because of its own correctable mistake.

mandatory_gates.name: Dynamic Intention focus
mandatory_gates.test: At material state changes the engine updates Measured Intent/hypothesis weights and prioritizes search using probability-weighted utility, decision sensitivity and cost-of-error while retaining alternatives that could materially change the outcome.

mandatory_gates.name: Decisive primary resolution
mandatory_gates.test: When evidence supports a useful decision-stable leading interpretation, Search returns the strongest defensible primary result without forcing a clarification question merely because alternate hypotheses still exist.

mandatory_gates.name: Bounded intent pivot affordances
mandatory_gates.test: When one or two materially supported alternate measured-intent outcomes remain plausibly competitive or decision-sensitive, Search exposes no more than two concise intent-pivot actions by default; speculative low-value branches are suppressed.

mandatory_gates.name: Same-session intent pivot continuation
mandatory_gates.test: Selecting a confirmation, alternate, deviation or deeper-search pivot preserves the current session/evidence, records the pivot, updates Measured Intent/hypothesis weights, invalidates only obsolete derived state, and continues from the furthest valid state.

metric_layer.name: Measured Intent
metric_layer.definition: The portion of user intent CARBON can defensibly infer, weight, test and support with evidence.
metric_layer.objective: Maximize Measured Intent resolution while minimizing material Expected Regret.
metric_layer.boundary: Unknown or merely hypothesized intent must remain explicitly uncertain.

matrix_distribution.mode: single versioned shared engine with thin Matrix-wide adapters
matrix_distribution.anti_pattern: copied or forked intent-engine logic per worker/model

intention.definition: Continuous evidence-bound orientation toward the best defensible resolution of Measured Intent.
intention.correction_rule: ACTIVE ERROR != END SEARCH; rollback affected derived state, preserve valid evidence, reweight, continue.
intention.prioritization: probability × intent utility × decision sensitivity × cost of being wrong
intention.surface_rule: same core engine; context/scope/permissions/actions/disclosure vary by caller

intent_branch_affordances.primary_rule: resolve first; do not interrogate first when a defensible primary result exists
intent_branch_affordances.pivot_rule: offer only materially supported parallel outcomes that could plausibly improve or materially change the user's measured-intent outcome
intent_branch_affordances.continuation_rule: pivots continue the existing session and evidence chain; they do not silently rewrite history
